## ⚠️ This repository does not accept pull requests

Agentic Copilot is proprietary software and **no application source code lives here**. This repository exists only so users can report issues.

If you spotted a mistake in this repository's own documentation or issue templates, please [open an issue](../../issues/new/choose) instead and we'll correct it.

If you're reporting a bug or requesting a feature in the app, use the [issue templates](../../issues/new/choose).

Thanks for taking the time either way.
